agents.name: Explorer
agents.description: Extracts basic metadata: titles, descriptions, language, resource info
agents.prompt_template:
You are given a dataset context with fields: url, title, description, publisher, frequency, fetched_content.

Extract metadata using this EXACT JSON structure:
{
  "titles": [{"name": "value of title field", "title_type": "MainTitle", "language": "es"}],
  "descriptions": [{"description": "value of description field", "description_type": "Abstract", "language": "es"}],
  "languages": [{"lang_code": "es", "language": "Spanish"}],
  "resource": {
    "identifier": "value of url field",
    "identifier_type": "URL",
    "resource_type": "Dataset",
    "resource_type_general": "Dataset",
    "language": "es"
  }
}

CRITICAL RULES:
- Use field name 'name' not 'title'
- Use field name 'description' not 'text'  
- Use field name 'lang_code' not 'code'
- Put the url value into resource.identifier
- Infer language from content (es for Spanish)
- Omit any field where you have no data

agents.description: Extracts dates, temporal events, geo locations
agents.prompt_template:
Extract temporal and geographic info. Use 'frequency' field if available.

EXACT JSON structure:
{
  "dates": [{"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "date_type": "Issued"}],
  "temporal_events": [{"frequency_type": "monthly", "description": "update frequency"}],
  "geo_locations": [{"geo_location_place": "country or region name"}]
}

CRITICAL: Use 'geo_location_place' not 'place'. Use ISO 8601 dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Map frequency: Mensual=monthly, Diario=daily, Semanal=weekly, Anual=yearly. Extract geographic scope from content.
